college_identity.identity_notes: One of ten new NITs sanctioned in 2009 during the 11th Five-Year Plan, established 2010; mentored initially by NIT Tiruchirappalli. Located in Karaikal — a non-contiguous coastal enclave of the Union Territory of Puducherry, geographically distant (~140-150km per one source) from Puducherry city itself. Permanent campus (~256-258 acres) in Thiruvettakudy/Poovam villages, inaugurated 2016. CRITICAL DISAMBIGUATION: explicitly verified DISTINCT from Puducherry Technological University (formerly Pondicherry Engineering College, PEC), a separate, older (est. 1984), unrelated state institution actually located in Puducherry city proper — confirmed directly by a Careers360 Karaikal-city listing page showing both institutions side by side. One search result referencing 'NIT Kolkata' was identified as either a mislabeled or non-existent institution (no such NIT exists among the standard 31) and was excluded entirely from this extraction.
